bio: Hospitality and conviviality are the bedrock of this cosy little restaurant in the heart of Amsterdam, where you can enjoy good food in a relaxed atmosphere. Rogier van Dam's dishes are full of character, and nothing on the plate is superfluous. If he serves up a fillet of venison, the whole dish revolves around that ingredient. Naturally, there is also a focus on sauces and creative garnishes. The dessert of brioche stuffed with creamy Époisses is a classic of the house, and rightly so!...
